abstractFills.basis: javadoc (abstract, no default): a 1.21.2 type has no sync codec or predicate, so it cannot be synchronized; Fabric's sync code casts every type answering true to its own AttachmentTypeImpl

ledger.net/fabricmc/fabric/api/attachment/v1/At: not bridgeable: a 1.21.2 builder builds types that cannot be synchronized -- 1.21.3's Fabric sync code (AttachmentTargetsMixin, the chunk / entity / world sync mixins of fabric-data-attachment-api-v1 1.4.0) reads the packet codec and sync predicate off Fabric's own AttachmentTypeImpl, which only Fabric's BuilderImpl makes, and no API attaches them to another type; accepting the call and building an unsynced type would silently drop the synchronization the caller asked for
